$comment: WinCleanKit action catalog. Every entry is data, not code. `id` must be unique and stable (used by -Only/-Skip and by restore logs). `risk` is described in docs/CATALOG.md.

categories.name: Windows ads & suggestions
categories.description: Turns off Microsoft's own promotional surfaces: Start menu recommendations, Settings suggestions, lock-screen Spotlight ads, search-box web suggestions, widget feed, and the desktop 'Learn about this picture' icon.
categories.description_zh: 关闭微软自家推广位：开始菜单推荐、设置页建议、锁屏 Spotlight 广告、搜索框联网推荐、小组件资讯流、桌面“了解此图片”图标。

categories.name: Telemetry & diagnostic data
categories.description: Stops diagnostic data collection: the DiagTrack service, compatibility appraiser, CEIP uploads, error reporting and feedback requests.
categories.description_zh: 停止诊断数据采集：DiagTrack 服务、兼容性评估、CEIP 上报、错误报告与反馈请求。

categories.name: Preinstalled apps
categories.description: Uninstalls consumer UWP apps and revokes their provisioning so they cannot be reinstalled silently. All of them can be reinstalled from the Microsoft Store.
categories.description_zh: 卸载消费类 UWP 应用并撤销预置，防止被静默重装。全部都可以从 Microsoft Store 重新安装。

categories.name: OneDrive
categories.description: Removes the OneDrive client binaries and blocks reinstall. Your OneDrive data folder is NEVER touched.
categories.description_zh: 移除 OneDrive 客户端程序并阻止重装。你的 OneDrive 数据目录【绝不会】被触碰。

categories.name: Privacy hardening
categories.description: Advertising ID, input personalization, implicit text/ink collection, location, settings sync and per-app diagnostic access.
categories.description_zh: 广告标识符、输入个性化、文本/手写隐式采集、定位、设置同步、应用诊断信息访问权限。

categories.name: Ad image cache & wallpaper
categories.description: Deletes already-downloaded Spotlight ad images. Refuses to touch your current wallpaper or its transcoded copy.
categories.description_zh: 删除已下载的 Spotlight 广告图。不会触碰你当前的壁纸及其转码副本。

actions.title: Forbid silent app installation
actions.title_zh: 禁止静默自动安装应用
actions.why: This single flag is what lets Windows drop promoted apps into your Start menu without asking. It is the root cause of most 'where did this app come from' bloat.
actions.why_zh: 就是这个开关让 Windows 不询问就往你开始菜单塞推广应用。大多数“这应用哪来的”都是它干的。
actions.name: SilentInstalledAppsEnabled

actions.title: Disable subscribed content (recommendations/ads)
actions.title_zh: 关闭订阅内容(推荐/广告)
actions.why: Master switch for all Microsoft-pushed subscribed content on the user account.
actions.why_zh: 微软向该用户账号推送的所有订阅内容总开关。
actions.name: SubscribedContentEnabled

actions.title: Disable Windows Spotlight desktop ad
actions.title_zh: 关闭桌面 Spotlight 广告图
actions.why: Subscribed content 338389 is the desktop wallpaper/icon Spotlight promotion.
actions.why_zh: 订阅内容 338389 即桌面壁纸/图标形式的 Spotlight 推广。

actions.title: Disable lock screen ad overlay
actions.why: The 'fun facts, tips and more' overlay drawn on top of your lock screen picture is an ad surface.
actions.why_zh: 锁屏图片上那层“有趣的事实、提示等”浮层就是广告位。
actions.name: RotatingLockScreenOverlayEnabled

actions.title: Disable lock screen Spotlight rotation
actions.title_zh: 关闭锁屏 Spotlight 轮播
actions.why: Stops Windows rotating lock screen images, which is the delivery vehicle for lock screen ads.
actions.why_zh: 停止锁屏图片轮播——这是锁屏广告的投放载体。
actions.name: RotatingLockScreenEnabled

actions.title: Disable Settings / Start suggestions
actions.title_zh: 关闭设置与开始菜单建议
actions.why: Removes the suggested-apps and tips rows injected into Settings and Start.
actions.why_zh: 移除注入到设置和开始菜单里的推荐应用与提示行。
actions.name: SystemPaneSuggestionsEnabled

actions.title: Disable content delivery
actions.why: Turns off the content-delivery pipeline that carries tips and promotions.
actions.why_zh: 关闭承载提示与推广的内容投递管道。
actions.name: ContentDeliveryAllowed

actions.title: Disable OEM preinstalled app promotions
actions.title_zh: 禁止 OEM 预装应用推广
actions.why: Blocks OEM-supplied app promotion slots.
actions.why_zh: 阻止 OEM 提供的应用推广位。
actions.name: OemPreInstalledAppsEnabled

actions.title: Disable soft landing / welcome pages
actions.title_zh: 关闭欢迎与提示落地页
actions.why: Stops the 'look what you can do' landing pages after updates.
actions.why_zh: 停止更新后弹出的“看看你能做什么”落地页。
actions.name: SoftLandingEnabled

actions.title: Remove Start menu Recommended section ads
actions.title_zh: 移除开始菜单“推荐”区推广
actions.why: Removes promoted apps from the Start menu Recommended area.
actions.why_zh: 移除开始菜单“推荐”区里的推广应用。
actions.name: Start_IrisRecommendations

actions.title: Disable recent-file suggestions
actions.title_zh: 关闭最近使用文件建议
actions.why: Stops recently used files being surfaced as suggestions.
actions.why_zh: 不再把最近使用的文件作为建议展示。
actions.name: Start_TrackDocs

actions.title: Hide taskbar Widgets button
actions.title_zh: 隐藏任务栏小组件按钮
actions.why: The Widgets button opens a feed of news and sponsored content.
actions.why_zh: 小组件按钮打开的是资讯与赞助内容流。
actions.name: TaskbarDa

actions.title: Hide taskbar Chat (Teams) button
actions.why: Removes the preinstalled Chat/Teams promotion from the taskbar.
actions.why_zh: 从任务栏移除预装的聊天/Teams 推广位。
actions.name: TaskbarMn

actions.title: Hide desktop 'Learn about this picture' icon
actions.title_zh: 隐藏桌面“了解此图片”图标
actions.why: The Spotlight desktop icon is a promotional entry point on top of your wallpaper.
actions.why_zh: Spotlight 桌面图标是叠在你壁纸上的推广入口。
actions.name: {2cc5ca98-6485-489a-920e-b3e88a6ccce3}

actions.title: Disable search box web suggestions
actions.why: Stops the search box sending your keystrokes to Bing and rendering sponsored results.
actions.why_zh: 不再把键入内容发往 Bing 并展示赞助结果。
actions.name: DisableSearchBoxSuggestions

actions.title: Hide Settings home page promos
actions.title_zh: 隐藏设置首页推广区块
actions.why: The Settings home page carries promotional cards. Hiding it is a visible UI change.
actions.why_zh: 设置首页带推广卡片。隐藏它会改变你看到的设置界面。
actions.name: SettingsPageVisibility

actions.title: Disable Edge promotional tabs & recommendations
actions.title_zh: 关闭 Edge 推广标签页与推荐
actions.why: Turns off Edge's promotional tab that appears after updates. Does NOT remove or disable the Edge browser itself.
actions.why_zh: 关闭更新后出现的 Edge 推广标签页。不会移除或禁用 Edge 浏览器本身。
actions.name: PromotionalTabsEnabled

actions.title: Disable 'set Edge as default' popup
actions.title_zh: 关闭“将 Edge 设为默认”弹窗
actions.why: Stops Edge nagging you to become the default browser.
actions.why_zh: 不再反复提示你把 Edge 设为默认浏览器。
actions.name: DefaultBrowserSettingEnabled

actions.title: Disable Windows consumer features
actions.title_zh: 禁止 Windows 消费者功能
actions.why: The machine-wide policy that stops Windows auto-installing promoted apps and games.
actions.why_zh: 机器级策略，阻止 Windows 自动安装推广的应用与游戏。
actions.name: DisableWindowsConsumerFeatures

actions.title: Disable Spotlight features
actions.why: Machine-wide policy disabling Windows Spotlight promotional surfaces.
actions.why_zh: 机器级策略，禁用 Windows Spotlight 的各推广位。
actions.name: DisableWindowsSpotlightFeatures

actions.title: Disable third-party app suggestions
actions.why: Stops Microsoft suggesting third-party apps it is paid to promote.
actions.why_zh: 不再推荐微软收了推广费的第三方应用。
actions.name: DisableThirdPartySuggestions

actions.title: Opt out of tailored experiences
actions.why: Stops your diagnostic data being used to personalise ads and tips.
actions.why_zh: 不再用你的诊断数据来个性化广告与提示。
actions.name: DisableTailoredExperiencesWithDiagnosticData

actions.title: Set diagnostic data to lowest allowed level
actions.title_zh: 诊断数据设为最低级别
actions.why: Sets AllowTelemetry=0. On Pro/Home Windows reports this as 'Required' — security/quality data still flows. Only Enterprise/Education honours a true zero.
actions.why_zh: 设置 AllowTelemetry=0。在专业版/家庭版上系统会显示为“必需”，安全与质量数据仍会发送。只有 Enterprise/Education 才能真正归零。
actions.name: AllowTelemetry

actions.title: Set legacy AllowTelemetry to 0
actions.why: Older builds read the value from the legacy path; setting both is safer.
actions.why_zh: 旧版本从旧路径读取该值，两处都写更保险。
actions.name: AllowTelemetry

actions.title: Disable OneSettings downloads
actions.title_zh: 禁止 OneSettings 配置下载
actions.why: Stops Windows fetching remote configuration payloads used for experiments and staged rollouts.
actions.why_zh: 不再下载用于实验与灰度推送的远程配置载荷。
actions.name: DisableOneSettingsDownloads

actions.title: Stop Windows asking for feedback
actions.why: Suppresses 'give us feedback' notifications.
actions.why_zh: 不再弹出“给我们反馈”的通知。
actions.name: DoNotShowFeedbackNotifications

actions.title: Disable Application Impact Telemetry
actions.why: Stops per-application compatibility telemetry reporting.
actions.why_zh: 停止逐应用的兼容性遥测上报。
actions.name: AITEnable

actions.title: Disable installed-app inventory collection
actions.title_zh: 关闭已装应用清单采集
actions.why: Stops Windows inventorying your installed software for telemetry.
actions.why_zh: 不再为遥测目的清点你安装的软件。
actions.name: DisableInventory

actions.title: Disable User Activity Recording
actions.why: Stops Windows recording how you use applications.
actions.why_zh: 停止记录你的应用使用行为。
actions.name: DisableUAR

actions.title: Turn off Customer Experience Improvement Program
actions.title_zh: 关闭客户体验改善计划(CEIP)
actions.why: Opts the machine out of the CEIP data programme.
actions.why_zh: 让本机退出 CEIP 数据计划。
actions.name: CEIPEnable

actions.title: Disable Windows Error Reporting
actions.title_zh: 关闭 Windows 错误报告
actions.why: Stops crash reports being sent to Microsoft. Trade-off: crashes will no longer be uploaded for analysis.
actions.why_zh: 不再向微软发送崩溃报告。代价：崩溃不再上传分析。
actions.name: Disabled

actions.title: Disable DiagTrack service
actions.why: Connected User Experiences and Telemetry — the core service that uploads diagnostic data.
actions.why_zh: “连接用户体验和遥测”——上传诊断数据的核心服务。
actions.name: DiagTrack

actions.title: Disable dmwappushservice
actions.why: WAP push message routing, used by the telemetry pipeline.
actions.why_zh: WAP 推送消息路由，供遥测管道使用。
actions.name: dmwappushservice

actions.title: Disable Windows diagnostic infrastructure services
actions.title_zh: 禁用 Windows 诊断基础结构服务
actions.why: WdiServiceHost and WdiSystemHost run diagnostic scenario traces.
actions.why_zh: WdiServiceHost 与 WdiSystemHost 负责运行诊断场景跟踪。
actions.name: WdiServiceHost

actions.title: Disable WdiSystemHost service
actions.why: Diagnostic system host.
actions.why_zh: 诊断系统宿主。
actions.name: WdiSystemHost

actions.title: Disable Windows Error Reporting service
actions.title_zh: 禁用 Windows 错误报告服务
actions.why: Stops the error reporting service. Trade-off: no crash reporting at all.
actions.why_zh: 停止错误报告服务。代价：完全没有崩溃上报。
actions.name: WerSvc

actions.title: Disable Program Compatibility Assistant service
actions.title_zh: 禁用程序兼容性助手服务
actions.why: PCA watches what you run and reports compatibility data. Trade-off: no automatic compatibility fixes.
actions.why_zh: PCA 监视你运行的程序并上报兼容性数据。代价：失去自动兼容性修复。
actions.name: PcaSvc

actions.title: Disable Compatibility Appraiser task
actions.why: Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser Exp is one of the largest telemetry collectors on Windows.
actions.why_zh: Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser Exp 是 Windows 上采集量最大的遥测任务之一。
actions.name: Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser Exp

actions.title: Disable CEIP Consolidator task
actions.title_zh: 禁用 CEIP 汇总上传任务
actions.why: Aggregates and uploads Customer Experience Improvement data.
actions.why_zh: 汇总并上传客户体验改善数据。
actions.name: Consolidator

actions.title: Disable USB CEIP task
actions.title_zh: 禁用 USB 使用数据采集任务
actions.why: Collects and uploads USB device usage data.
actions.why_zh: 采集并上传 USB 设备使用数据。
actions.name: UsbCeip

actions.title: Disable feedback upload tasks
actions.why: DmClient and DmClientOnScenarioDownload upload feedback and scenario data.
actions.why_zh: DmClient 与 DmClientOnScenarioDownload 上传反馈与场景数据。
actions.name: DmClient

actions.title: Disable MareBackup task
actions.why: Compatibility telemetry reporting task.
actions.why_zh: 兼容性遥测上报任务。
actions.name: MareBackup

actions.title: Disable error report queue task
actions.title_zh: 禁用错误报告排队任务
actions.why: Queues error reports for upload.
actions.why_zh: 将错误报告排队等待上传。
actions.name: QueueReporting

actions.title: Turn off advertising ID
actions.why: Apps can no longer use a per-user advertising identifier to profile you.
actions.why_zh: 应用无法再用每用户广告标识符对你画像。
actions.name: Enabled

actions.title: Disable input personalization
actions.why: Stops typing/inking data being collected to build a personal dictionary in the cloud.
actions.why_zh: 不再采集键入/手写数据用于构建云端个人词典。
actions.name: Enabled

actions.title: Block implicit text collection
actions.why: Prevents Windows silently sampling your typing.
actions.why_zh: 阻止 Windows 静默采样你的输入内容。
actions.name: RestrictImplicitTextCollection

actions.title: Block implicit handwriting collection
actions.why: Prevents Windows sampling your handwriting.
actions.why_zh: 阻止 Windows 采样你的手写笔迹。
actions.name: RestrictImplicitInkCollection

actions.title: Stop handwriting data sharing
actions.why: Blocks handwriting recognition data being shared with Microsoft.
actions.why_zh: 阻止手写识别数据被共享给微软。
actions.name: PreventHandwritingDataSharing

actions.title: Disable location services
actions.why: Turns off system location. Trade-off: Maps, weather and 'find my device' become less useful.
actions.why_zh: 关闭系统定位。代价：地图、天气、“查找我的设备”等功能受限。
actions.name: DisableLocation

actions.title: Disable settings sync to Microsoft account
actions.title_zh: 关闭设置同步到微软账号
actions.why: Stops your personalisation settings syncing to the cloud. Trade-off: settings no longer follow you to other PCs.
actions.why_zh: 不再把个性化设置同步到云端。代价：换电脑时设置不再跟随。
actions.name: SyncPolicy

actions.title: Block apps reading diagnostic information
actions.title_zh: 禁止应用读取诊断信息
actions.why: Per-app permission: no app may read diagnostic data about your device.
actions.why_zh: 逐应用权限：任何应用都不得读取你设备的诊断数据。
actions.name: LetAppsAccessDiagnosticInformation

actions.title: Never ask for feedback
actions.why: Sets the feedback request cadence to zero.
actions.why_zh: 把反馈请求频率设为 0。
actions.name: NumberOfSIUFInPeriod

actions.title: Stop Delivery Optimization peer-to-peer sharing
actions.title_zh: 关闭传递优化 P2P 共享
actions.why: Your PC stops uploading update fragments to strangers. Trade-off: slightly slower updates. The service itself is kept enabled.
actions.why_zh: 你的电脑不再向陌生人上传更新分片。代价：更新可能略慢。服务本身保留启用。
actions.name: DODownloadMode

actions.title: Uninstall Clipchamp
actions.why: Bundled video editor with a paid tier. Reinstallable from the Store.
actions.why_zh: 捆绑的视频编辑器，含付费档。可从 Store 重装。
actions.name: Clipchamp.Clipchamp

actions.title: Uninstall Dev Home
actions.why: Developer dashboard most users never open.
actions.why_zh: 多数人从不打开的开发者仪表盘。
actions.name: Microsoft.Windows.DevHome

actions.title: Uninstall Power Automate
actions.why: Automation host that runs in the background.
actions.why_zh: 后台常驻的自动化宿主。
actions.name: Microsoft.PowerAutomateDesktop

actions.title: Uninstall new Outlook (web wrapper)
actions.title_zh: 卸载新版 Outlook(网页套壳)
actions.why: The Store Outlook is a web wrapper. SKIP THIS if you use it for mail.
actions.why_zh: Store 版 Outlook 是网页套壳。如果你用它收发邮件，请跳过此项。
actions.name: Microsoft.OutlookForWindows

actions.title: Uninstall Media Player (ZuneMusic)
actions.why: Groove successor with store promotions. SKIP if you play local media with it.
actions.why_zh: Groove 的继任者，带商店推广。如果你用它播放本地媒体，请跳过。
actions.name: Microsoft.ZuneMusic

actions.title: Uninstall Xbox app & Game Bar overlay
actions.title_zh: 卸载 Xbox 应用与 Game Bar 覆盖层
actions.why: Xbox app, Game Bar overlay, TCUI and identity provider. These are the pieces that pop up over games. SKIP if you use Game Pass, achievements or Game Bar recording.
actions.why_zh: Xbox 应用、Game Bar 覆盖层、TCUI 与身份提供程序——就是在游戏上弹窗的那套。如果你用 Game Pass、成就或 Game Bar 录屏，请跳过。
actions.name: Microsoft.GamingApp

actions.title: Uninstall Xbox Game Bar overlay (TCUI)
actions.title_zh: 卸载 Xbox Game Bar 覆盖层(TCUI)
actions.why: The Xbox overlay shell. SKIP if you use Win+G recording.
actions.why_zh: Xbox 覆盖层外壳。如果你用 Win+G 录屏，请跳过。
actions.name: Microsoft.XboxGamingOverlay

actions.title: Uninstall Solitaire Collection
actions.why: Ships with adverts inside the game.
actions.why_zh: 游戏内自带广告。
actions.name: Microsoft.MicrosoftSolitaireCollection

actions.title: Uninstall Office Hub placeholder
actions.title_zh: 卸载 Office Hub 占位应用
actions.why: A Store advert for Microsoft 365, not actual Office.
actions.why_zh: 这是 Microsoft 365 的商店广告，不是真正的 Office。
actions.name: Microsoft.MicrosoftOfficeHub

actions.title: Uninstall Microsoft To Do
actions.why: Task app. SKIP if you keep your to-do list here.
actions.why_zh: 待办应用。如果你在这里记待办，请跳过。
actions.name: Microsoft.Todos

actions.title: Uninstall Feedback Hub
actions.why: Microsoft's feedback collection app.
actions.why_zh: 微软的反馈收集应用。
actions.name: Microsoft.WindowsFeedbackHub

actions.title: Uninstall Get Help
actions.why: Support contact app most users never open.
actions.why_zh: 多数人从不打开的技术支持应用。
actions.name: Microsoft.GetHelp

actions.title: Uninstall Phone Link
actions.why: Links your phone to the PC. SKIP if you use it.
actions.why_zh: 把手机连到电脑。如果你在用，请跳过。
actions.name: Microsoft.YourPhone

actions.title: Uninstall Quick Assist
actions.why: Remote assistance tool. SKIP if your IT support uses it to help you.
actions.why_zh: 远程协助工具。如果 IT 支持靠它帮你，请跳过。
actions.name: MicrosoftCorporationII.QuickAssist

actions.title: Uninstall Sticky Notes
actions.why: SKIP if you keep notes on your desktop.
actions.why_zh: 如果你在桌面上记便签，请跳过。
actions.name: Microsoft.MicrosoftStickyNotes

actions.title: Uninstall Windows Maps
actions.why: Offline map app almost nobody opens on a desktop.
actions.why_zh: 台式机上几乎没人打开的离线地图。
actions.name: Microsoft.WindowsMaps

actions.title: Uninstall Bing News
actions.why: Ad-funded news feed, usually arrives via silent install.
actions.why_zh: 靠广告变现的资讯流，通常经静默安装落地。
actions.name: Microsoft.BingNews

actions.title: Uninstall Bing Weather
actions.why: Ad-funded weather app, usually arrives via silent install.
actions.why_zh: 靠广告变现的天气应用，通常经静默安装落地。
actions.name: Microsoft.BingWeather

actions.title: Uninstall Bing Search app
actions.title_zh: 卸载 Bing 搜索应用
actions.why: Web-search wrapper injected into the Start menu.
actions.why_zh: 注入开始菜单的网页搜索套壳。
actions.name: Microsoft.BingSearch

actions.title: Remove OneDrive client and block reinstall
actions.title_zh: 移除 OneDrive 客户端并阻止重装
actions.why: Deletes the OneDrive binaries and sets a machine policy that blocks sync and reinstall. YOUR DATA FOLDER IS NEVER TOUCHED — it stays on disk exactly as it is, and nothing is uploaded or deleted.
actions.why_zh: 删除 OneDrive 程序本体并设置机器级策略阻止同步与重装。你的数据目录【绝不会】被触碰——原样留在磁盘上，不会上传也不会删除。

actions.title: Delete downloaded Spotlight ad images
actions.title_zh: 删除已下载的 Spotlight 广告图
actions.why: Removes already-downloaded promotional images. It does NOT touch your wallpaper or its transcoded copy.
actions.why_zh: 删除已下载的推广图片。不会触碰你的壁纸及其转码副本。
